2.2 Endocrine Regulation

Hormones regulate growth, metabolism, and reproduction.

Examples: - Insulin lowers blood glucose by increasing cellular
uptake. - Glucagon raises blood glucose via glycogenolysis. - Cortisol
modulates stress response and inflammation.

Disorders: - Diabetes mellitus type 1 and type 2 - Cushing syndrome -
Addison disease

metadata.document_summary: This research article explores the mechanisms of hormone regulation and its impact on related disorders. It provides insights into the physiological processes and pathological conditions associated with endocrine regulation, aiming to enhance understanding among medical professionals.
